costNote: Mostly the crops themselves — corn, soy and other commodities ADM buys from farmers — plus processing. It runs at 92 cents per revenue dollar; ADM's profit lives in the thin spread on top.

opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: Running the global origination, trading and processing network, plus corporate functions.

opex.name: Impairment, exit & restructuring
opex.note: Only $5M this quarter — versus $246M a year ago. The non-repeat of those charges is a big part of why profit jumped.

otherDetail.label: Equity earnings of affiliates
otherDetail.note: ADM's share of profits from joint ventures and stakes, chiefly Wilmar.

otherDetail.label: Interest & investment income
otherDetail.note: Interest and returns on financial assets.

footerNote: Net earnings are the consolidated $826M including non-controlling interests; $821M was attributable to ADM. Segment revenue is revenue from external customers per the Q3 2026 Form 10-Q segment note.

segments.name: Ag Services & Oilseeds
segments.note: Sourcing, trading, transporting and crushing soy and other oilseeds. Segment operating profit more than doubled to $778M on a constructive biofuels market and strong North American execution.

segments.name: Carbohydrate Solutions
segments.note: Starches, sweeteners and corn processing (incl. ethanol via Vantage). Operating profit rose to $470M from $336M.

segments.name: Nutrition
segments.note: Human and animal nutrition ingredients — the higher-margin growth bet. Operating profit edged up to $134M even as revenue dipped.

segments.name: Other business
segments.note: Smaller activities outside the three reportable segments, including captive insurance.

takeaways.text: EPS of $1.70 versus $0.22 a year ago — last year's quarter carried $246M of impairment and restructuring charges plus weaker crushing margins; this year segment operating profit grew in all three segments.
takeaways.title: Profit surged off a low base

takeaways.text: Ag Services & Oilseeds operating profit more than doubled to $778M (crushing alone $311M vs $13M), riding biofuel demand and ADM's North American footprint.
takeaways.title: Oilseeds did the heavy lifting

takeaways.text: Management raised full-year adjusted EPS guidance to about $5.50–$5.80 (from $5.15–$5.60) and expects Q4 operating profit to improve year over year in every segment.
takeaways.title: Guidance raised again

verdict: A biofuel-fueled rebound: revenue up 10%, profit up nearly eightfold off a charge-heavy year-ago quarter, and guidance raised.
